items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: They say Walter Bloom, wasn't it? That man was invited parade, you see? He was a good man

ctx.x: What about Buddy? Did he get out in the street much? Buddy?

Oh, he was a parade man. Buddy was more parade man than what Kelly was. Kelly was a parade man too, but he wasn't like Buddy. The man, huh, Joe Olive. They say Walter Bloom, wasn't it? That man was invited parade, you see? He was a good man and more, I was calling the name, but I can't think of.
I think we better call it to a halt, that's about the end of this reel. I think four reels will be enough for a day. We sure do appreciate it.
